verdict.rationale: stagewise is itself an agentic IDE with built-in coding agents, so it fills the MCP-client role; serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Its GitHub, Supabase and Figma plugins are client-side integrations and do not count here. Nothing in the evidence shows stagewise running as an MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' mode or a hosted MCP endpoint.
